Fit ABC posteriors for multiple subjects or donors

Source: R/abc.R
mbmm_abc_bank.Rd

Applies mbmm_abc_fit to each subject in a named observation list and stacks the accepted particles.

Usage

mbmm_abc_bank(
  obs_list,
  simulate_fn,
  prior_sample_fn,
  n_draws = 10000,
  n_keep = NULL,
  accept_frac = 0.025,
  distance_fn = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  failure = c("discard", "error"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

obs_list

Named list of subject observation data.frames.

simulate_fn

See mbmm_abc_fit.

prior_sample_fn

See mbmm_abc_fit.

n_draws

See mbmm_abc_fit.

n_keep

See mbmm_abc_fit.

accept_frac

See mbmm_abc_fit.

distance_fn

See mbmm_abc_fit.

seed

Base random seed. Subject i uses seed + i.

failure

See mbmm_abc_fit.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

A stacked particle data.frame with donor IDs. Subject-level ABC diagnostics are stored in the "abc_diagnostics" attribute.
